title: Now Available: Lendflow's Equipment Financing Workflow
summary: Explore Lendflow's Equipment Financing Workflow, a guided experience for equipment financing applications, document collection, and lender offers in one borrower portal.
body_markdown:
For businesses purchasing machinery, vehicles, or other essential equipment, access to financing can determine how quickly they can expand operations or take on new projects. Yet equipment financing often requires coordinating with vendors, gathering bank statements, and comparing different lending options. Lendflow's new Equipment Financing Workflow brings these steps into one guided digital experience, helping brokers and business owners submit financing requests and move toward lender offers without managing disconnected applications.


### A Dedicated Financing Experience for Equipment Purchases


Equipment financing differs from general working capital lending because the equipment typically secures the financing. Lenders consider the type, condition, value, and useful life of the asset alongside the business using it. The workflow supports purchases of machinery, trucks, shop equipment, and medical equipment, including new and used assets from dealers or private sellers. It also provides paths for refinancing and sale-leaseback transactions. Financing and leasing options depend on lender eligibility and availability. Brokers can use Lendflow's white-label capabilities to provide a branded experience while maintaining customer relationships.


### How the Equipment Financing Workflow Works


The guided application has five main stages: equipment details, business information, guarantor details, document collection, and final review. Once submitted, the borrower can follow the request and view available offers through Lendflow's Borrower Platform.


‍


### Step 1: Select Equipment Financing


The applicant starts by choosing Equipment Finance from the financing options alongside acquisition financing and commercial real estate. The selection page explains who the product serves, what financing may be available, and what information is needed to get started.


‍


### Step 2: Describe the Equipment and Financing Request


Applicants choose whether the transaction is a purchase, refinance, or sale-leaseback. They then select the equipment type, enter a description or make and model, and provide the equipment cost and any down payment. These inputs help establish the financing request. The application also notes that lenders may finance a significant share of equipment cost, and a down payment is not always required.


‍


### Step 3: Enter Equipment and Business Details


The next step asks whether the equipment is new or used. Applicants can enter the dealer or vendor, when the equipment is needed, year, hours or miles, serial number or VIN, and equipment location. These details are particularly useful when valuing used assets. The workflow also collects information about the operating business, since lenders evaluate both the asset serving as collateral and the business that will use it. Bringing these details together helps brokers avoid repeated information requests.


‍


### Step 4: Provide Guarantor Information


Equipment lenders may also evaluate the owner or guarantor. This step captures the guarantor's home address, city, state, ZIP code, liquid funds available, and estimated credit score range. The experience explains why the information matters and builds on contact details already collected, helping create a more complete financing file without separate forms.


‍


### Step 5: Upload Equipment and Financial Documents


The application provides a dedicated place to upload an equipment quote or invoice showing the make, model, and price, along with recent business bank statements. The example requests three months of statements. Borrowers can attach the files they already have and provide remaining documents later through their secure application portal. This flexibility helps initiate lender review without waiting for every document to be assembled upfront.


‍


### Step 6: Review and Submit the Application


Before submission, applicants review the transaction and equipment details in one summary. The screen includes the transaction type, equipment category, description, condition, vendor, year, hours or miles, serial number, equipment cost, and down payment. They can return to earlier steps to make corrections. This final check reduces avoidable errors and gives brokers a clearer view of the request being submitted.


### Step 7: Send the Request to Lending Partners


After submitting, applicants receive confirmation that their financing request is in. The file moves toward lender review, and borrowers are directed to their portal to view offers as they arrive. For brokers, centralized intake reduces the need to re-enter the same information across different lender applications. Response times depend on lender review and the transaction.


### Step 8: Review Financing Offers in One Portal


Lendflow's Borrower Platform provides a central place to review eligible offers and follow the application through processing, offers, closing, and funding. Borrowers can also manage documents and track next steps. This gives brokers and applicants greater visibility throughout the financing process. Offer availability and terms remain subject to lender underwriting and approval.


‍


### Helping Equipment Financing Brokers Scale


Equipment requests can range from a single work truck to high-value construction or medical machinery. Each asset may require different lender criteria and documentation. Lendflow standardizes the application process while preserving asset-specific details, connecting borrowers with financing partners through a single experience. Brokers can spend less time chasing paperwork and more time helping businesses understand their options. White-label capabilities also allow partners to keep their brand at the center of the borrower experience.


‍


### Get Started With Lendflow's Equipment Financing Workflow


Lendflow's Equipment Financing Workflow offers a more organized way to manage equipment purchases, refinances, and sale-leasebacks. To learn about lender connectivity, white-label options, and how to offer the workflow to your customers, contactcustomersuccess@lendflow.com .
